comment: Books on the chapel library shelf. Short pages, read aloud on request. Scripture books are paraphrases and need theological review before release.

books.title: The Lord Is My Shepherd
books.review_status: DRAFT: child-friendly paraphrase; requires theological and editorial review before release.
pages: The Lord is my shepherd. I have everything I need.
He lets me rest in green meadows. He leads me beside quiet waters.
He makes me strong again, and he shows me the right paths to walk.
Even when the way is dark, I will not be afraid, because you are close beside me.
You set a table for me, and my cup is so full it spills over.
Your goodness and your love will follow me all my life, and I will live in your house forever.

books.title: In the Beginning
books.review_status: DRAFT: child-friendly retelling; requires theological and editorial review before release.
pages: In the beginning, God made the heavens and the earth.
God said, "Let there be light," and there was light. God called the light day, and the darkness night.
God made the wide sky above, and gathered the waters below.
God made dry land appear, and filled it with plants and trees, each with its own seeds.
God made the sun to shine by day, and the moon and stars to shine by night.
God filled the waters with fish and the sky with birds.
God made the animals of the land, and then God made people, a man and a woman, to be like him and to care for all he had made.
God saw everything he had made, and it was very good. On the seventh day, God rested.

books.title: A Seed's Journey
pages: A seed lies asleep in the dark, cool soil.
Rain soaks into the ground, and the sun warms the earth. The seed wakes up.
A tiny root pushes down into the soil, to drink and to hold on tight.
A little shoot pushes up, bent like a loop, until it reaches the light.
Leaves open wide to catch the sun. Day by day, the plant grows taller.
Flowers bloom, and bees come visiting.
And inside each flower, new seeds are growing, ready for next spring.
